messages.subject: Shiny ui.r and server.r files
parts:
I have a pretty basic question. Where are the ui.r and server.r files located after publishing a Shiny App?
When i first published the Shiny App, I obviously saved the ui.r and server.r scripts on my computer and after some time those files became corrupted. The Shiny App still functions properly but i would like to make some updates and was wondering if the Published ui.r and server.r scripts were located somewhere.

Thanks. 
Joe

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Shiny ui.r and server.r files
parts:
You can download a bundle of your application from the shinyapps.io dashboard page for the application, on the overview tab.

http://docs.rstudio.com/shinyapps.io/applications.html#downloading-your-application
